correctness.rationale: For distinct incident original edges {u,v},{u,w}, midpoint values differ by (f_v-f_w)/2; for a simple graph each line-graph adjacency has precisely one common endpoint, including triangles. Coarea on real input f and linearity reduce the operator seminorm exactly to cut indicators, producing 1/(2|∂S|)sum_u s_u(d_u-s_u). Rewriting each wedge count as sum over crossing edges of h_u+h_v with h_u same-side degree proves the n-2 bound and equality iff each incident boundary vertex has all same-side neighbors. On a tree, each edge appears in d_u+d_v-2 wedges under the triangle inequality, and deleting a maximizer bridge gives equality. Small graph and cycle boundaries were checked. This is an all-graph analytic argument; diagnostics are finite only.
